text:
Absolutely disgusting! I’m actually in disbelief to have come across a McDonalds branch that is so badly kept. I’ve never needed to review a Mcdonalds in my life, because I’ve had the assumption that they all delivered a consistent level of service. Boy was I wrong! From the moment we walked it, you could tell that something was wrong. Seats were ripped up and there was chaos around the whole store.

I managed to grab a table for my family after a group had just left; however, they left the table dirty. I went to the counter to ask if someone could give it a wipe down, and the lady at the till just handed me some tissues and cleaning spray. I basically became a cleaner for 2 minutes at this branch. I am not a stuck up person, but how can you expect customers to clean up after other customers mess? Poor level of customer service and awareness.

I then went and ordered our meal using the digital screens, and took up the option to have the food delivered to our table. After 30 minutes it never came. Lo and behold, when I went to the front counter, our food was there on a tray with our table number on top. Why didn’t someone bring it over!? We then had an uncomfortable experience of other customers bringing their pets inside, so I had to fight off these dogs from eating my lunch. Why isn’t there a policy to make pet owners eat on the tables outside?!

Also couldn’t find French fries on the menu, so had to settle for these awful wedges. However, hidden in my wife’s wedges was a random French fry that managed to sneak its way in. If chips are being cross contaminated, then I wonder what else is….

When I went to the counter to ask where to find the toilets, nobody seemed interested in talking to me when they saw me approaching. It’s clear that there isn’t a manager at this branch.

Also, don’t order to ‘eat in’ if you care about hygiene. They bring your food in these recycled containers that feel like something from a child’s nursery. How do they even wash those containers properly? Yuck - put me off my food!
author: E Aca

text: While we were eating there, we felt like we were part of a social experiment. We waited 30 minutes without our order being processed. When we asked what was going on, a half-interested clerk told us that our order would be ‘remade’ and that we could wait at our table. After another 20 minutes, a woman arrived with our tray, which was full of water and Coke, and our food was floating in it. See the picture below for proof. When we asked her what had happened, she replied, "Don't you want it?" I thought we were in a simulation because the scene I was witnessing couldn't be real. Not at McDonald's. When we said the food was not edible that way, she replied the order would be remade. Then she vanished. Twenty minutes later, I went to the counter and told them I wouldn't leave until my food was ready. About 10 minutes later, our order was served. For some reason, the hamburgers were cold when they arrived. We ate our food and left in disbelief. We've never seen anything even close to this at the busiest McDonald's we've ever visited. The parent company needs to intervene immediately. This place is ruining their reputation. Thousands of people visit this location every day. All staff should be retrained. The manager should be fired.
author: Riccardo Valboni

text: Probably one of the best views you could ever hope for from a Maccies, sat on the French Riviera in Nice. Stunning. Unfortunately McDonald's can't take much credit for the view, although they did choose the location. Back to the McDonald's - service was polite and friendly, although a little slow. This is something I have found in France - they are generally not in a rush to get on with service in any cafe or restaurant (fair enough). It had been quite busy and as a result there were plenty of dirty tables and packaging left around the place. The food was decent enough, no complaints there - different menu options from the UK McDonald's, so that was good.* Just revised the review after a second visit, where unfortunately food was missed of the order and what did come was stone cold. THE worst McDonald's I have ever had. We weren't even going to be told there was no beer available and given an alternative choice.
author: James Howard

text:
Nicely renovated McDonald's but so slow.
I was waiting 25 min for bigmac and two mochas. I had to approach an employee and ask why is it taking forever to make a bigmac when the store is empty, 80% of tables are not occupied and all people are just standing in front of the counter waiting for the orders endlessly. Guy told me to move on the side and keep waiting, after what he went across the store to closed  McCafe counter, grabbed two cups for my mocha and brought them through the entire store to the main counter, touching all people jackets and contaminating them. Finally 15 minutes after I got my bag. Total 40 min for one bigmac and two mochas.
Also they charge you a McCafe price for special crafted drinks but in fact everything is poured out of automatic Melita machine , no craft
And chocolate syrup wasn't even stired properly
author: Jeff Montana

text: I went here in early July 2025 around 4:30 pm and this is by far the worst mcdonalds I have been to worldwide. Upon entering it stank, there was a congestion of people waiting for their food and it was extremely hot due to the air conditioning not being on or present. After waiting 33 minutes, we saw our full order ready behind the counter (4 simple burgers) and asked if we could have our food. The person behind the counter told us to wait until our order was called. We ended up having to wait another 13 minutes for our order to be called and to our great surprise :) the food was cold. The thought was to grab a quick lunch and then continue exploring the beautiful city of Nice, but what a letdown this was. So definitely skip this mcdonalds!!!
author: Merlin-Oscar van Diepen

text: AVOID AT ALL COST! The floors are dirty and full of trash, spilled juices are just smeared across the floor instead of cleaned, toiletes are clogged, everything was covered in urine around the urinal, you had to step in all of that because it was at least half a cm deep, sink was full of blood and clogged and the pipes for water were not working, there was no toilet seat and no toilet paper, heating is turned up so high it's impossible to sit on the top floor, we had to clean the table we were sitting at ourselves because nobody cared enough to clean them... All in all this place is such a mess it's probably breaking every single public health and safety regulation ever...
author: Karlo Akrap

text:
Difficult to put into words how shockingly poor my experience at this McDonald’s was. The absence of urgency, care or competence was nothing short of astonishing.

Ordered 1x cheeseburger, 1x double cheeseburger and 1x medium fries to takeaway on the digital screens inside, and waited for 45 MINUTES at the counter for them to serve our order. In that time the pace of serving orders was the worst I’ve ever witnessed in a McDonald’s. No one in charge, ~30 people waiting for their order at any one time, no communication from staff and barely any movement in the kitchen.

Would be hard pushed to find a worse McDonald’s in France, possibly Europe.
author: Danny Barry

text:
Going in to the restaurant was like entering a sauna. The interior temperature was warmer than the air outside. Also the pipes were leaking, and there were 3 buckets on the ground nearly full of water. I ordered my food and expected it to be ready in 5-10 minutes due to the place being a fast food restaurant. After 10 minutes I've seen my order ready and on the counter but after that I had to wait another 15 minutes for them to give me my food. From the 10+ employees at maximum 5 was working, the others just wandered around. I ate my not surpisingly cold food, which also had a not too appetizing outlook.
Overall a very bad experience.
author: Szabolcs Dombovari

text:
Yesterday we waited 25 minutes for our order. The Coca-Cola we received was flat and had no ice, even though we specifically ordered it with ice.
Today we came for McBreakfast around 9:30 AM – there were very few people, yet I waited 15 minutes for an egg and cheese burger! The bun was cold (improper defrosting). They replaced it, but the second one was also cold. The burger ended up in the trash.
The staff walk around like sleepy flies, doing nothing! McDonald’s is supposed to be fast food – hot, tasty, and FAST.
This is by far the worst McDonald’s I’ve ever been to in any country.
author: Anastasiia Altukhova

text:
Worst mcd I have ever been in the world. Staff are simple bored about their job. They had incomplete trays of food waiting in line yet nobody serve at table. I had to ask at the overcrowded counter to get my order and it lack of salad. Upon asking, the guy simply tell me ‘what salad?’ And he checked there is no more and he just walk away. Nobody seems to care about customers. 0/10 can Mcdonald’s look into this branch and do something about it? It ruins the image of the whole chain.
** ice cream already melted when served
** machine already ran out of ink and nothing was printed
author: k C

text:
A DISASTER! last Sunday we were waiting 30 minutes for our two meals, today we were waiting 50(!!!)minutes for TWO McFlurries, and I don’t know how long we would have been waiting if I didn’t ask after 50 minutes! Revoke the franchise license from this restaurant, that’s anything but a McDonald’s!

Other than the extremely long wait: two McFlurries, two different quantities. Shouldn’t the quantity of every single product be kinda standardized?

Plus: this facility is in a nasty condition, sticky floor and surfaces, leftover food and packaging all over the place.
author: Aleksandar Herceg

text: Hello whoever is the manager of McDonalds on the Promenade des Anglais. Do you care? Have you taken a look recently at your reviews on google? This is I think the flagship restaurant in Nice. Lots of tourists must come off the beach and step inside. But it is an absolute disaster. Please do something if you have any inch of pride. The way the entrance is organised is terrible, its dirty, it's dark and poky and completely uninvitiing. This place needs a complete makeover. I went in and out very quickly because this is just not on.
author: Kokeshi Kokeshi

text:
It is absolutely disgusting in here. The food is rancid, the place smells and is so dirty. I sat next to a table with food, sauce(possibly straight out of someone’s mouth) all over it for over an hour… no one came to clean it. Im really not sure if they wash these reusable tableware. The toilet is shared between men woman and children all in one space… you can see the urinals. If you are gluten intolerant dont even dream of eating here. You can get a patty with cheese on it in a plastic box.
Traumatizing experience.
author: Nóra Varga

text: We just stopped with a bunch of friends for FAST FOOD. Honestly this place is a disgrace and I don’t know if anyone is in charge or even cares about meeting the minimum required standards of public health and safety. Food took 37 minutes to be ready, it is 33-34 degrees Celsius inside and no air to breathe, in existent manager and the “cherry on the top” is the super slow and ironically enough, also rude staff. If you wanna find out go and check it yourself!
author: Lazaron Gusho

text: For which reason on earth do you have this things and the opportunity to select the "service a table" option if you don't serve at the table? It took me 30 minutes (and that's my fault) to realize that my food would never been arrived and after I asked about it you have given me a stone-cold hamburger. Which by the way made me think about how just terrible fast food products are, since normal meat is still good enough after few minutes of waiting.

text: I've never been so disappointed in a McDonald's restaurant before. The staff was clearly not motivated, it took 1 hour and 5 minutes to get a cold burguer/fries. The food stayed on the table for ages and not delivered to clients, people screaming asking for money back. My experience was terrible and I strongly advise not to try this restaurant. Below see a picture of dozens drinks waiting to get delivered to clients, same for food. INSANE!!!

text: We spent 40 minutes waiting at the counter for our order. During that time, the service was incredibly slow—easily the worst I’ve experienced at a McDonald’s. There seemed to be no one managing the situation, with around 30 people constantly waiting and no updates or communication from staff. The kitchen activity was minimal, and the whole place felt disorganized. SO Please do not waste you're time here !!!

text: What you see on the picture is one very cold burger from the worst run McDonalds I’ve ever been to!!! They had a bearded guy manning the counter where you pick up your order and he did nothing else than looking busy and talking to his friends visiting!! Saw by burger being put into the paper bag and waited for 10 minutes before I asked him to pick it up and give it to me! Don’t spend your money there.

Food was very stale and poor quality, plus we waited over 25 mins for our food. Not recommended.

text:

text:

Chips were freezing, burger was the same and never got our drinks. If they had left the food outside it would have been hotter! Avoid this mcdonalds

text: I’ve been to McDonald’s all over the world and this by far has been the worst one. Waited over 45 mins for just two diet cokes. Staff were incredibly unhelpful and didn’t seem to take their job seriously. Playing around and not paying attention to customers. I wish I could give this place zero stars.

text: I ordered tea, which I waited for 47 minutes. 47 minutes to wait for one tea! I did not wait and went to another place. I have never had such a long tea in my life. The order was never brought and I left. Twice I went to the cash register and was nervously told to wait. I went to another place. 👎
